auth.subtitle: Access your data securely
auth.modeTitle: How do you want to use Fintrack?
auth.modeDescription: Your data is always stored in SQLite. Cloud access is optional and can be enabled or disabled at any time.
auth.chooseCloudDescription: Sign in to synchronize data between devices while keeping the SQLite copy.
auth.chooseLocalDescription: No account or Firebase connection. Everything remains in your SQLite database.
auth.modeChangeLater: You can change modes at any time from Settings.
auth.signOutConfirmMessage: Fintrack will close the cloud session on this device. Local data remains stored in SQLite.
auth.sessionRemembered: You will stay signed in on this device until you sign out.
auth.connectCloudConfirmMessage: This will close emergency local access and return to the cloud sign-in screen.
auth.offlineAccessDescription: Unlocks only this device's SQLite copy. Cloud remains disconnected until you sign in.
auth.offlinePinInvalidFormat: Enter all 6 digits of the PIN.
auth.offlinePinLocked: Too many attempts. Try again in {{seconds}} seconds.
auth.offlinePinUnavailable: The local PIN could not be verified.
auth.resetSent: If the account exists, you will receive an email to change your password.
auth.privateAccess: Accounts cannot be created from this screen. Use an authorized Fintrack account.
auth.continueLocalDescription: You can use the app without Firebase and enable cloud access later.
auth.localDataProtectedDescription: This database is already linked to a cloud account. Sign in with that same account to access it; signing out does not make the data available in local mode.
auth.databaseUnavailableTitle: The local database could not be verified
auth.databaseUnavailableDescription: Fintrack has blocked access for safety. Retry to verify which account this database is linked to.

errors.emailRequired: Enter your email address to reset your password.
errors.invalidEmail: The email address is not valid.
errors.invalidCredentials: The email address or password is incorrect.
errors.network: Could not connect. Check your Internet connection.
errors.tooManyAttempts: Too many attempts. Wait a few minutes before trying again.
errors.wrongAccount: This local database is linked to another account. Sign in with the original account.
errors.databaseUnavailable: The local database protection could not be verified. Please retry.
errors.generic: Could not sign in. Please try again.

settings.title: Settings
settings.description: Configure the app and keep control of your data from one place.
settings.storageModeLocalDescription: Fintrack only uses SQLite on this device and does not initialize Firebase.
settings.storageModeCloudDescription: SQLite remains the primary source and changes are synchronized automatically with Firebase.
settings.offlineAccessActive: Local copy unlocked with the emergency PIN
settings.offlineAccessDescription: You can work in SQLite. You must sign in to cloud again before sending or receiving changes.
settings.offlineAccessSafety: Changes remain pending and are not sent to any account while this mode is active.
settings.offlinePinDescription: Lets you open this SQLite file with a 6-digit PIN if Firebase is unavailable. It does not replace your cloud password.
settings.offlinePinSaveError: The local PIN could not be saved.
settings.offlinePinDisableConfirm: Without this PIN, you cannot open the local copy after signing out when Firebase is unavailable.
settings.offlinePinDialogDescription: Choose 6 digits that are different from your Firebase password. Only a cryptographic verifier is stored.
settings.offlinePinInvalidFormat: The PIN must contain exactly 6 digits.
settings.offlinePinMismatch: The two PIN entries do not match.
settings.storageModeSafety: Changing modes never deletes or replaces local data.
settings.syncConflictDescription: Fintrack has not overwritten either version. Choose which copy to keep for those months.
settings.syncConflictKeepLocalConfirm: Local data for {{count}} months will be kept and uploaded as a new version.
settings.syncConflictUseCloudConfirm: Local data for {{count}} months will be replaced by the cloud version. Your saved JSON backup can restore it.
settings.preferencesDescription: Adapt the app to the way you manage your data.
settings.dataManagementDescription: Import, export, or create a backup without depending on the cloud.
settings.databaseLocationDescription: View or change where the local SQLite file is stored.
settings.databaseLocationMobileDescription: On Android, Fintrack stores SQLite in the app's protected internal storage.
settings.databaseLocationMobileHelp: To move your data to another device, use Export backup and Import backup in JSON format.
settings.inputHelp: Paste a folder or a .db file path.
settings.dialogUnavailable: Folder picker is unavailable in this build.
settings.readOnlyDescription: Disables saving, importing, and deleting data.
settings.investmentPortfolioDescription: Enables portfolio, total wealth, and related calculations.
settings.updateIdle: Press check to look for updates.
settings.exportDescription: Download your history as CSV or SQL.
settings.backupDescription: Save or restore a full backup. You can also download your data as CSV.
settings.backupMissingPath: Could not resolve the current database path.
settings.backupImportConfirmMessage: Fintrack {{version}} backup with {{count}} months: {{newCount}} new, {{changedCount}} changed and to be overwritten, and {{unchangedCount}} already identical. All other local months will remain.
settings.backupImportReadOnly: Disable read-only mode to import a backup.
settings.backupInvalidJson: The file does not contain valid JSON.
settings.backupInvalidFormat: The file is not a Fintrack backup.
settings.backupUnsupportedVersion: This backup version is not supported yet.
settings.backupInvalidData: The backup contains incomplete or invalid data.
settings.saveConfirmMessage: This will update the database path.
settings.closeConfirmMessage: You have unsaved changes. Close without saving?

messages.rotateDevice: Rotate your device to view the chart in landscape.

dialogs.confirmDeleteMonthMessage: This will delete data for month {{month}}. This action cannot be undone.
dialogs.confirmDeleteYearMessage: This will delete all records for year {{year}}. This action cannot be undone.
dialogs.confirmDeleteAllMessage: This will delete all saved records. This action cannot be undone.

errors.importType: Could not determine the import type.
